 A SMALL PLACE FOR GOOD APPS

About Awesome Mac

A Mac software directory maintained by Balaji Sivasakthi, built from the Awesome Mac Apps repository. Apps link to their official product page or maintainer repository. Downloads and purchases happen with their developers.

Listings are editorial selections, not security audits. Pricing and compatibility may change; check the official website before installing. Saved apps stay in this browser.

Sources & licensing

Catalog text is adapted from collections by jaywcjlove, serhii-londar, iCHAIT, and Open Saas Directory. Catalog content uses CC BY 4.0, with original MIT notices retained where applicable. App names and software belong to their respective owners.
